text.div: Deliberately non-conformant Patient. This resource claims conformance to the HL7® AT Core Patient profile in meta.profile but carries two social security numbers, while the profile allows at most one (slice Patient.identifier:socialSecurityNumber, max = 1). It is valid against the base FHIR R4 Patient resource, so a FHIR server accepts it on create. Only profile validation can reject it. Used as the negative control for the AT Core profile validation test script.
